title: spec: the script.config.template tombstone points authors at sys_notification_template, which notify's own `template` key superseded (ruling D on #24770)
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the spec-lane half of execution card ② of the maintainer's ruling D on #24770 (「决策箱 三张同意」, recorded by triage in `6293376907`). The decision `6290342354` names "the two stale texts". The other text (`authentication.mdx`) stays on #24924. This one sits in `packages/spec/src/**`, the contract surface, so it is spec-lane work. Filed by the `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118, `os-support-ai`, session `session_01UmqzD97e14iws6hmVhgZ5y`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's (expected `domain:spec`).

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:spec` seat. It edits tombstone prose and its regenerated reference only.

## The stale text

`packages/spec/src/automation/schemaless-node-config.zod.ts` (about `:353-358` on `main` `2941a1929`): the `script.config.template` tombstone tells authors "stored templates live in the messaging service (`sys_notification_template`), not on the node". That predates notify's own `template` key, which names an email template (`email_template`). Under ruling D, `sys_notification_template` takes only the `email` and `sms` channels (#24924). A notify node that names a `template` uses that email template on every channel.

## The fix

- Rewrite the tombstone's prescription to point at notify's `template` key (an `email_template`).
- Mention `sys_notification_template` only as what the `email` and `sms` channels read when no template is named.
- Regenerate the reference page the tombstone feeds.
- No schema shape changes: prose only.

## Dedupe

Method: a semantic `search_issues` query on objectstack-ai/objectstack, open and closed, with the tombstone's own words. 3 hits: #24924 (the services half, the sibling of this card), #22054 and #4616 (closed, different subjects). **New.**
